title: 1RB0RE_0RC---_1LD1LE_1LE1LD_1RF0LC_1RA1RF: the ten crossing turns without a witness are safe for every clean far part, in Lean
text: The 10 crossing turns of the list machine that the witness lemma did not cover come in six windows right after E reads the last 1. Lean proves each window safe for whole families of states (every prefix, every clean far part), and also that the near part alone is not enough: with a far part starting u u the same window fails at once. What remains is about the far parts the growing phase builds.
